boxes.meaning: to trouble someone, impose on them

examples.english: Please don't trouble yourself; I can carry it myself.
examples.traditional: 唔好麻煩你喇，我自己攞得喇。
examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 maa4 faan4 nei5 laa3 ngo5 zi6 gei2 lo2 dak1 laa3

examples.english: Sorry to impose on you again and ask you to look after my cat.
examples.traditional: 唔好意思，今次又要麻煩你幫我睇住隻貓。
examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 gam1 ci3 jau6 jiu3 maa4 faan4 nei5 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 zek3 maau1
